profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou and listed on NASDAQ under the ticker EH. According to its own website, it describes itself as a world's leading autonomous aerial vehicle (AAV) technology platform company, with a mission to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. The company says it provides AAV products and commercial solutions across urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media solutions, and describes itself as a forerunner of AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global Urban Air Mobility industry.

The site lists product and solution areas including passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions, alongside sections for news, partners, investor relations, and careers. The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001759783. No lawsuits, additional tracked products, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
